import ast
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.games import make_game
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path=Path('results/training/qwen38_test_finish_completion.json'); assert not path.exists()
launch_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_test_finish.json'); launch=json.loads(launch_path.read_text());assert launch['status']=='outputs_retrieved'
selection_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_selection.json'); selection=json.loads(selection_path.read_text());assert file_sha256(selection_path)==launch['selection_sha256']
root=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-test-finish-v1'); label=selection['label']; work=root/label
original=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-selected-test-v1')/label/'results'
source=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_test_finish/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py');assert file_sha256(source)==launch['source_sha256']
core=next(n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text())) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='write_text' and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Constant))
assert (root/'evaluate_core.py').read_text()==core
pair_path=root/'pair_runtime.json'
pair=json.loads(pair_path.read_text()) if pair_path.exists() else None
runtime_path=work/'runtime.json'
runtime=json.loads(runtime_path.read_text()) if runtime_path.exists() else None
cohorts={}; copied={}
for game in ('dice','cards'):
 raw=work/f'results/raw/{game}/{label}.jsonl'
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()] if raw.exists() else []
 prefix=original/f'raw/{game}/{label}.jsonl'
 if rows:
  assert raw.read_bytes().startswith(prefix.read_bytes()), 'Original acquired bytes must remain unchanged'
  assert [r['seed'] for r in rows]==list(range(200,200+len(rows))) and len(rows)%4==0
 for row in rows:
  ep=make_game(game).episode(row['seed']);cfg=row['provenance']['config']
  assert row['value']==ep.value and len(row['rounds'])==6 and [r['reveal'] for r in row['rounds']]==ep.reveals
  assert cfg['seed']==0 and cfg['eval_batch_size']==4 and cfg['adapter_sha256']==selection['adapter_sha256']
  assert cfg['revision']==selection['provenance']['model_revision']
 reference=raw.with_name('bayes.jsonl');refs=[json.loads(line) for line in reference.read_text().splitlines()] if reference.exists() else []
 complete=len(rows)==200 and len(refs)==200
 if complete:
  assert [r['seed'] for r in refs]==list(range(200,400))
  for source_raw in (raw,reference):
   target=Path(selection['test_root'])/f'raw/{game}'/source_raw.name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   if target.exists(): assert file_sha256(target)==file_sha256(source_raw)
   else: shutil.copyfile(source_raw,target)
   copied[str(target)]=file_sha256(target)
 cohorts[game]={'episodes_in_rerun_output':len(rows),'reference_episodes':len(refs),'original_episodes_retained':len(prefix.read_text().splitlines()),'complete':complete,
  'file':str(raw) if raw.exists() else None,'sha256':file_sha256(raw) if raw.exists() else None,'original_file':str(prefix),'original_sha256':file_sha256(prefix),
  'effective_episodes':max(len(rows),len(prefix.read_text().splitlines()))}
log=next(root.glob('*.log')); log_text=log.read_text()
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Retain the ONE missing-only 27B test continuation and close GPU submissions'},selection['provenance']['model_revision']),
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'complete' if all(c['complete'] for c in cohorts.values()) else 'closed_partial_retained',
 'launch_sha256':file_sha256(launch_path),'selection_sha256':file_sha256(selection_path),'cohorts':cohorts,'runtime':runtime,'pair_runtime':pair,
 'canonical_copies':copied,'downloaded_files':{str(p):{'sha256':file_sha256(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
 'terminal_status':launch['polls'][-1]['output'],'no_more_reruns':True,
 'scope':'Original version remains immutable. Only complete games scored, no partial extrapolation. This closes the one rerun authorized by the finish-now directive.'}
if 'AssertionError: []' in log_text and 'prefixes' in log_text:
 record['cause']='Kaggle omitted the ERROR test kernel from the saved input mounts; evaluation-prefix lookup found no raw prefix and failed before new inference. Requested and pulled metadata discrepancy is retained in the launch receipt.'
else: record['cause']='See exact downloaded log and worker runtime; do not infer an error cause from a terminal status alone.'
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(p.read_text());session=next(s for s in ledger['sessions'] if s['kernel']==launch['metadata']['id'] and s['version']==launch['version'])
session.update(status=record['status'],hours=pair['wall_seconds']/3600 if pair else None,script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'] if pair else None,
 result_file=str(pair_path) if pair else str(log),hours_basis='No wrapper runtime was flushed before prefix lookup failed; measured script hours unavailable. Official account billing is retained separately.')
ledger['final_submission_closure']={'status':'closed','reason':'Owner authorized one final bounded missing-only test continuation; terminal outputs retained. No further reruns or optional validation submissions.', 'completion_receipt':str(path)}
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Final 27B retained counts',{g:c['effective_episodes'] for g,c in cohorts.items()},record['status'])
